requirement: Implement a service test mock builder create_repository_mock that enforces strict signature validation against the target interface UserRepository. Mocks must reject non-existent methods and invalid call signatures (missing required args, unknown kwargs) with TypeError or AttributeError using autospec=True / create_autospec.
skeleton: Interface class UserRepository and factory build_user_repo_mock().
caption: A standard-library repository mock factory built on unittest.mock.create_autospec that keeps the mock faithful to the real interface's method names and signatures, with no third-party imports. UserRepository defines find_by_id(user_id, include_deleted defaulting to False), returning a user dictionary, and update_status(user_id, new_status), returning True. build_user_repo_mock creates an autospec of UserRepository with instance set to True, so the result behaves like an instance rather than a callable class, then sets the return value of the autospecced find_by_id to a Mock User dictionary with id 1 and of update_status to True, keeping both methods under signature enforcement instead of replacing them with plain mocks. Accessing a method the interface does not define raises AttributeError, and calling a method with a missing required argument or an unknown keyword raises TypeError. safe_invoke_repo(repo, method_name, args, kwargs) raises TypeError when handed a callable class instead of an instance, looks the method up with getattr, and calls it, letting any AttributeError or TypeError propagate instead of returning None. The fixture asserts that find_by_id(1) returns the Mock User dictionary and update_status returns True, that a non-existent method raises AttributeError, that calling find_by_id without its argument raises TypeError, that the mock is not callable and update_status through the invoker returns True, that an unknown keyword on find_by_id raises TypeError, and that invoking a missing method through the helper raises AttributeError.

plan.intent: Build a repository mock that enforces the real interface
constraints: The mock is an instance autospec of the repository class
Return values are set on the autospecced methods so signatures stay enforced
A missing argument or an unknown keyword raises TypeError
Invoking through the helper with a callable class raises TypeError and propagates errors

rationale.teaches: A repository mock built with create_autospec instance=True, so unknown methods raise AttributeError and wrong signatures raise TypeError, with return values set on the autospecced method and errors propagated.
rationale.why: A plain Mock accepts any method and any arguments, so a test against it passes even after the interface changes. The fixture calls a non-existent method and a wrong signature and expects errors.

ops.docstring: Build signature-checked repository mocks and refuse to call the class itself.

candidates.why_wrong: A bare Mock is returned, so any method name and any arguments are accepted.
spec without autospec checks attribute names but not signatures, so a call with a missing argument passes.
instance=False autospecs the class, so calling the mock returns an instance mock and method calls need self.
find_by_id is replaced with a plain Mock, so its signature is no longer enforced.
TypeError and AttributeError are swallowed and None is returned, so a signature mismatch looks like a successful call.
